summary: The repo has a hardcoded live API key, a SQL injection vulnerability, a division-by-zero bug, and a bare except that swallows errors. These are the main issues to fix.

findings.title: Hardcoded live API key
findings.detail: A live secret key is committed in source; should be loaded from environment/secret store.

findings.title: SQL injection in get_user
findings.detail: User input is concatenated directly into the SQL query, allowing injection.

evidence.quote: query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + name + "'"

findings.title: Division by zero in average
findings.detail: average([]) raises ZeroDivisionError; main() calls report_scores([]) which triggers it.

findings.title: Bare except swallows all errors
findings.detail: load_config catches every exception (including KeyboardInterrupt) and returns {}, hiding real failures.

findings.title: File handle not closed
findings.detail: load_config opens the file without a context manager, leaking the handle on error paths.
